name: bifrost-cost-tpm
description: Test 3 on Bifrost transports/v2.2.6, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway key (limits in the run's NOTE.md and quota.json). A token limit of 1000 a minute. Checked as usage >= limit before the call, with usage charged after the response: one at a time, the request that crosses is admitted and the next refused; at once, every request that starts below the limit is admitted, so a burst can overshoot (LiteLLM reserved each request's worst case and refused bursts early).
